summary: The source contract permits at most 300 method calls and fixes the active window at 300 seconds, so the legal domain cannot support an honest asymptotic runtime-scaling verdict.

workload_bound.source_constraint: At most 300 total calls are made to hit and getHits.

replacement_checks.evidence: Each hit reads and writes one ring slot, each query examines exactly 300 slots, and the two arrays contain exactly 600 entries regardless of call distribution or same-second burst size.

The certificate regression checks the app-local and native implementations with no hits, every possible hit age from 0 through 300 seconds, slot reuse, and 299 same-second hits followed by a query at the 300-call limit.
